name: remove-ai-marks-chatgpt
description: ChatGPT-native text hygiene and natural rewriting workflow with accurate reporting of what was actually changed.

interface.longDescription: A self-contained ChatGPT workflow for inspecting text for unnecessary invisible characters and rewriting formulaic prose more naturally while preserving meaning. It does not claim to prove human authorship or guarantee detector evasion.
capabilities: Inspect pasted text for unnecessary invisible or control characters
Rewrite formulaic prose in clearer, more natural language
Preserve facts, names, numbers, citations, URLs, and technical identifiers
